title: $L_p$ Brunn–Minkowski inequality for symmetric convex bodies
exact_target:
For origin-symmetric convex bodies $K,L\subseteq\mathbb R^n$ containing the origin in their interiors, let $h_K,h_L$ be their support functions. For $p>0$ and $0\leq t\leq1$, define the $L_p$ Wulff combination by
\[tK+_p(1-t)L=\bigcap_{u\in S^{n-1}}\{x:\langle x,u\rangle\leq(th_K(u)^p+(1-t)h_L(u)^p)^{1/p}\}.\]
At $p=0$, replace the right-hand side by $h_K(u)^th_L(u)^{1-t}$. Must $|tK+_p(1-t)L|\geq|K|^t|L|^{1-t}$ hold for every $p\geq0$?
